_comment: Standard-service capabilities copied from each fabricator's published capability page. Values in mm. Make sure the values are current before you release a design. Add your own fabricators in ipc_ste_manufacturers.json in the project folder (same format).

manufacturers.name: JLCPCB
manufacturers.notes: Annular ring: 0.18 mm minimum on 2-layer boards, 0.15 mm on multilayer. 0.25/0.20 mm recommended. Thickness above 2.5 mm only for 12+ layers. V-cut edge clearance 0.4 mm.

manufacturers.name: PCBWay
manufacturers.notes: 0.15 mm drill is possible at extra cost; 0.20 mm used as the standard minimum. Hole-to-hole and edge values are from the advanced table.

manufacturers.name: NextPCB
manufacturers.notes: 0.15 mm drill only for boards 1.2 mm thick or less. Hole-to-hole 0.30 mm for different nets, 0.20 mm for same-net vias.

manufacturers.name: PCB Power (Circuit Systems India)
manufacturers.notes: Track/space values are for 1 oz copper (0.09 mm possible at 0.5 oz outer). Drill is tool size. Annular ring is the inner-layer value (outer 0.10 mm). Mask dam 0.08 mm for green and blue.

manufacturers.name: Lion Circuits
manufacturers.notes: Custom service values. MII service: 2 and 4 layers only, 0.35 mm min drill, 1 oz only. 6+ layers need a request to sales. Thickness range not published; 0.4 to 3.2 mm assumed.
